newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Miss England wins Miss Europe 1996.
newsitem.headline: Miss England wins Miss Europe 1996.

text.p: Miss England, Marie-Claire Harrison, won the Miss Europe '96 beauty contest in Tirana on Saturday. Miss Belarus Yelena Shcherbak came second and Miss Israel Kim Rasliakova was third.
Harrison, a 23-year-old fashion model, becomes the 49th Miss Europe. She wins $20,000 and will also take home a traditional costume donated by Tirana City Hall.
Born in Clitheroe in Lancashire, Harrison said her hobbies were acting, water sports and eating cheese and pasta.
The contest, featuring 35 contestants from across Europe, took place in Albania's Palace of Congresses, a huge concrete monolith built to the glory of everlasting communism.
